description:
Activate Roxanne by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Roxanne enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Roxanne.
Resolve the Roxanne trigger, creating an untapped Meteorite token due to Archelos.
When the Meteorite enters, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.
